fullPassage: We encounter contrary claims about the relation of literature to action. Theorists have maintained that literature encourages solitary reading and reflection as the way to engage with the world and thus counters the social and political activities that might produce social change. At best it encourages detachment or appreciation of complexity, and at worst passivity and acceptance of what is. But on the other hand, literature has historically been seen as dangerous: it promotes the questioning of authority and social arrangements. Plato banned poets from his ideal republic because they could only do harm, and novels have long been credited with making people dissatisfied with their lives and eager for something new. By promoting identification across divisions of class, gender, and race, books may promote a fellowship that discourages struggle; but they may also produce a keen sense of injustice that makes progressive struggles possible. Historically, works of literature are credited with producing change: Uncle Tom's Cabin, a best-seller in its day, helped create a revulsion against slavery that made possible the American Civil War.

questions.passage: We encounter contrary claims about the relation of literature to action. Theorists have maintained that literature encourages solitary reading and reflection as the way to engage with the world and thus counters the social and political activities that might produce social change. At best it encourages detachment or appreciation of complexity, and at worst passivity and acceptance of what is. But on the other hand, literature has historically been seen as dangerous: it promotes __________. Plato banned poets from his ideal republic because they could only do harm, and novels have long been credited with making people dissatisfied with their lives and eager for something new. By promoting identification across divisions of class, gender, and race, books may promote a fellowship that discourages struggle; but they may also produce a keen sense of injustice that makes progressive struggles possible. Historically, works of literature are credited with producing change: Uncle Tom's Cabin, a best-seller in its day, helped create a revulsion against slavery that made possible the American Civil War.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 권위에 대한 의문 제기 (문학이 위험한 이유)
det.analysis:
❌ ① the obedience to power: 권력에 대한 복종은 문학이 위험하다는 맥락과 모순
❌ ② the denial of creativity: 창의성의 거부는 문학의 본질과 정반대
✅ ③ the questioning of authority: 원문 일치. 'it promotes the questioning of authority' ←정답
❌ ④ the reinforcement of control: 통제의 강화는 도전이 아닌 유지
det.tip: 문학이 위험한 이유 = 권위에 의문 제기

questions.passage: We encounter contrary claims about the relation of literature to action. Theorists have maintained that literature encourages solitary reading and reflection as the way to engage with the world and thus counters the social and political activities that might produce social change. At best it encourages detachment or appreciation of complexity, and at worst passivity and acceptance of what is. But on the other hand, literature has historically been seen as dangerous: it promotes the questioning of authority and social arrangements. Plato banned poets from his ideal republic because they could only do harm, and novels have long been credited with making people dissatisfied with their lives and eager for something new. By promoting identification across divisions of class, gender, and race, books may promote a fellowship that discourages struggle; but they may also produce a keen sense of injustice that makes progressive struggles possible. Historically, works of literature are credited with producing change: Uncle Tom's Cabin, a best-seller in its day, helped create __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 노예제에 대한 혐오감 (톰 아저씨의 오두막이 만들어낸 것)
det.analysis:
❌ ① a praise of Southern culture: 남부 문화 찬양은 글의 주장과 정반대
❌ ② a neutral view on servitude: 예속에 대한 중립적 견해는 혐오감과 반대
❌ ③ a support for the status quo: 현상 유지 지지는 변화 촉진과 모순
✅ ④ a revulsion against slavery: 원문 일치. 노예제에 대한 혐오감 ←정답
det.tip: Uncle Tom's Cabin → revulsion against slavery
